meta.siteDescription: Monthly ministry report for the Nyamira congregation. Report your service and keep your record.

common.strength0: Too weak. Use at least 10 characters and avoid common passwords.

landing.fallbackName: Nyamira Kingdom Hall of Jehovah's Witnesses
landing.metaDescription: Report your ministry each month, keep your own record, and sign in or ask for access.
landing.headline: Monthly ministry report
landing.lead: Report your service in under a minute, keep your own record, and see your progress.

legal.privacyDescription: What Ministry Report collects, who can see it, and what you can ask us to do.
legal.termsDescription: The terms for using Ministry Report in the Nyamira congregation.

install.title: Install the app
install.pageDescription: How to put Ministry Report on your phone's home screen.
install.intro: Open it like any other app, even with a weak connection.
install.androidSteps: Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
install.iphoneSteps: Tap the Share button, then choose Add to Home Screen. Use Safari.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: This page is not saved on your phone yet. Connect and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be wrong, or the page may have moved.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: Nothing was lost. Try again. If it keeps happening, tell an Elder.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Use your username or email and your password.

requestAccess.title: Request access
requestAccess.description: Ask to join Ministry Report. An Elder or Ministerial Servant approves each request.
requestAccess.lead: An Elder or Ministerial Servant will check your details before you can report.
requestAccess.fullNameHint: Write your name as the congregation knows it.
requestAccess.usernameHint: 3 to 24 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.
requestAccess.arrangementHint: A pioneer arrangement is confirmed by an Elder. Until then you report as a publisher.
requestAccess.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few random words work well.
requestAccess.consent: I have read the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy> and the <terms>terms</terms> and I agree.
requestAccess.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}.
requestAccess.checkEmailNext: After you confirm, sign in to add your photo. Then an approver will review your request.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.description: Ask for a link to choose a new password.
reset.lead: Enter your email and we will send you a link.
reset.sent: If that email belongs to an account, a link is on its way.
reset.noEmailHelp: No email? Ask an Elder for a one-time recovery link.

mfa.enrollLead: Elders and Ministerial Servants must use an authenticator app.
mfa.verifyLead: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code.
mfa.recoveryLead: Lost your phone? Use one of your saved recovery codes. It removes the old device so you can set up a new one.
mfa.step1: Scan the picture with an authenticator app, or type the key by hand.
mfa.step2: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.codesBody: These 10 codes are shown once. Each works one time. Store them offline, away from your phone.
mfa.recoveryHint: 10 letters and digits, for example ABCDE-23456.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.waitingBody: Your request is with the approvers.
pending.waitingNext: This page updates by itself when they decide. You can close it and come back.
pending.photoLead: Your request goes to the approvers once your photo is added.
pending.rejectedBody: An approver reviewed your request and could not approve it.

photo.gestureHelp: Drag to move and pinch to zoom, or use the slider and arrow buttons.
photo.saveFailed: The photo could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
photo.notImage: That file is not a picture. Choose a photo.
photo.tooBig: That photo is larger than 8 MB. Choose a smaller one.
photo.privacyNote: Only you and the Elders can see this photo of {name}. Location data is removed.

report.bannerLate: Late: reporting is still open until {end}.
report.blockedTitle: {month} can no longer be sent by you
report.blockedBody: The time to report it yourself has ended. Ask an Elder to submit it for you. Later months open after that.
report.commentHint: Up to 50 words. Do not write private details about other people.
report.noLocks: Nothing else is needed when you did not participate.
report.zeroHoursConfirm: You are reporting 0 hours. An Elder will see this flagged.
report.bigHoursConfirm: You are reporting {hours} hours. Check that this is correct.
report.lockWarning: You cannot edit this after submitting. You can ask an Elder to reopen it.
report.submittedBody: Your report for {month} was received on {time}.
report.reopenedBody: An Elder reopened this report so you can fix it. There is no deadline for this.
report.resubmittedBody: Your report is locked again. Thank you for fixing it.

log.title: Daily log
log.offlineNote: You are offline. New hours are saved on this phone and will send once you're back online.
log.syncing: {count, plural, one {# item waiting to send} other {# items waiting to send}}
log.empty: No hours logged for this month yet.
log.hoursToGo: {count, plural, one {# hour to go} other {# hours to go}}
log.miniChartAlt: Hours by month this service year

history.title: My reports
history.empty: Your first report will appear here after you submit it.
history.byElder: Submitted by an Elder on your behalf
history.correctionHelp: To correct a report, ask an Elder to reopen it.
history.correctionPending: Waiting for an Elder to decide
history.correctionDescription: Tell an Elder what to change and why. They will decide, then you can fix it here.

notifications.title: Messages
notifications.kind_account_approved: Your request was approved. You can now report.
notifications.kind_arrangement_requested: A service request is waiting for an Elder.
notifications.kind_profile_change_requested: A name or username change is waiting for an Elder.

settings.title: Settings
settings.phoneHint: Elders may use this to remind you.
settings.noArrangements: You report as a publisher. Request a pioneer arrangement below when it applies to you.
settings.startMonthHint: An Elder confirms the request before it counts.
settings.nameChangeHelp: An Elder approves these changes so the records stay accurate.
settings.changeWhat: What do you want to change?
settings.changeHint: You keep the current one until an Elder approves.

admin.noRequests: No requests are waiting. New ones appear here by themselves.
admin.approveDescription: Check that the name is the official one and the group is right.
admin.officialNameHint: Correct it here if it was typed differently.
admin.firstMonthHint: Set an earlier month if the person should still report it.
admin.rejectDescription: The person will see your reason.
admin.photoDescription: The request returns to the person with your note.
admin.changeName: {name} asks to change the official name to "{value}".
admin.changeUsername: {name} asks to change the username to "{value}".
admin.endDescription: Reports for months after the last month will be reported as a publisher.
admin.closedNote: {count, plural, one {# person was closed as did not report.} other {# people were closed as did not report.}}
admin.name: Name
admin.flagSelfEdited: An Elder submitted their own report
admin.approveReopenDescription: They will be able to fix it. There is no extra deadline.
admin.approveReopenBody: The report unlocks for the publisher to edit and resubmit.
admin.editDirectlyDescription: The report stays locked; you're changing its values in place.
admin.onBehalfDescription: Report for {month}. This is recorded in the audit log.
admin.categoryHint: Pioneer categories need an approved arrangement.
admin.receivedAtHint: When did the person send it? Leave empty for now. The time must be inside the reporting window.
admin.reasonHint: For example: sent by WhatsApp on the 9th.
admin.closeDescription: Record that no report for {month} will come. It shows as did not report and lets later months open.
admin.everyoneReported: Everyone has reported or been closed for this month.
admin.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}} to be on time
admin.daysOverdue: {count, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
admin.whatsappMessage: Hello {name}, a friendly reminder to submit your ministry report for {month}. It is due by {date}. You can report here: {link}
admin.addManaged: Add a member without a phone
admin.managedDescription: For a person without a phone or email. You submit their reports for them.
admin.makeServantDescription: They will approve new access requests.
admin.makeServantBody: They must set up two-factor sign-in the next time they sign in.
admin.removeServantBody: They go back to being a publisher.
admin.inactiveDescription: Use when a person moved or stopped reporting. History is kept.
admin.effectiveMonthHint: They will not count as did not report from this month.
admin.reactivateBody: They can sign in and report again.
admin.recoveryLinkHelp: Give this link to the person in private. It lets them choose a new password once.
admin.auditIntro: Every important action is recorded here. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

platform.title: Platform
platform.name: Name
platform.eldersHelp: Only you can grant or remove the Elder role.
